AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#317 @ f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf — VERDICT: BLOCK

Independent read-only **T4** audit of the complete `090bbf9ba2d223eb9010885e05c1141fb6e835ab..f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf` change and backend #623; health-data collection, local account/device authorization and persisted import correctness justify the stated tier. ([PR tier and scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317))

### A-317-1 — Critical / blocker: remote connection status authorizes uploading this phone's health store into another account

**Evidence:** `src/screens/client/wearables/WearablesShell.tsx:77-85` automatically calls import whenever the *server account* has a connected provider; `src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts:84-103` registers/reuses that account's connection and reads the *current phone's* store, without any local per-account connect authorization. ([Automatic refresh predicate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/screens/client/wearables/WearablesShell.tsx#L77-L92), [orchestration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L84-L108))

Reproduction: account A previously granted this app native health access on A's phone; account B, already connected on B's own phone, signs into A's phone and opens Health—B's remote row satisfies the new predicate, the existing app-level native grant permits A's store to be read, and samples are posted through B's connection/JWT without B choosing Connect on this device. ([Refresh trigger](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/screens/client/wearables/WearablesShell.tsx#L78-L85), [read and posting](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L160-L189))

The read-only source-loaded probe confirmed a remote B connection triggers a native read and a wire sample targeting `account-B-connection` without invoking the explicit Connect flow; JWT-only server identity correctly stamps B, but cannot determine that the underlying health store belongs to A. ([Automatic orchestration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L80-L109), [server identity boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5d451722db6e8e589c2bda0cc8295ba2eb8dd41/src/wearables/samples/wearable-samples.controller.ts#L237-L249))

**Minimal fix:** require explicit account-and-device-scoped local connect authorization before any automatic read/upload, not merely a remotely connected provider or OS app permission; require an explicit Connect on a new account/device, retire authorization on sign-out, and fence/cancel in-flight imports when session identity changes. Add the A-phone/B-account regression proving zero native reads and zero POSTs until explicit local Connect; do not add `userId` to the wire body.

### B-317-1 — High / must fix: provider-global cursors skip a different user's 30-day import

**Evidence:** `healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts:54,132-157,192` and `healthConnect/healthConnectSyncService.ts:36,85-99,172-202` use one persistent cursor per provider regardless of JWT account or connection ID; the new registration flow immediately reuses that cursor for any returned connection. ([Apple cursor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L132-L157), [Android cursor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectSyncService.ts#L85-L110), [registration-to-sync](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L88-L108))

The probe synced connection A at `2026-10-01T10:00Z`, then a new B connection at `10:05Z`: B's first import started at `2026-10-01T09:00Z`, not September 1, and only `healthkit_last_sync_at` existed in storage. ([Actual window computation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L146-L158))

**Minimal fix:** namespace progress by account/connection and provider, ignore/migrate the legacy global cursor without assigning it to a new identity, and cover account switch, new connection, deletion/recreation and sign-out/in-flight cursor writes; keep identity out of the POST body.

### B-317-2 — High / must fix: incomplete native reads are reported as completed imports and permanently advance progress

**Evidence:** `healthConnectClient.ts:275-291` returns success after page 20 even when another `pageToken` remains, while `healthConnectSyncService.ts:180-202` converts a granted-type read error to `[]` and advances the shared watermark to now. ([Pagination exit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectClient.ts#L273-L291), [error handling and watermark](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectSyncService.ts#L179-L202))

The probe returned 20 pages with a remaining token as an ordinary array, and a second probe with Steps successful/Weight throwing still returned success and wrote `2026-10-01T10:00Z`; the next five-minute overlap cannot recover the omitted history. ([Read bound](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectClient.ts#L244-L291), [overlap and completion](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectSyncService.ts#L47-L53))

Apple has the analogous progress hazard: `healthKitClient.ts:307-312` silently drops a native reader failure, then any other nonempty metric permits the global cursor to advance. ([Apple reader settlement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitClient.ts#L305-L312), [Apple progress write](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L173-L192))

**Minimal fix:** explicitly represent complete/partial/error reads; retain progress for failed/truncated types, resume bounded pages or split bounded time windows, and never close the sheet as a completed 30-day import when data remains unread. The simplest safe first repair is to reject incomplete granted-type reads and retain the cursor, with bounded resumable handling for page-limit exhaustion; test page 21 and transient reader failure/recovery.

### B-317-3 — High / must fix: Apple 30-day sleep history is collapsed into one “night,” and overlap replay has different dedup keys

**Evidence:** `healthkit/healthKitNormalizer.ts:371-439` sums every sleep segment in the entire query into one metric sample spanning earliest start to latest end; the newly wired importer calls this once over the 30-day window. ([Sleep normalization](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitNormalizer.ts#L371-L439), [import window](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L153-L168))

Two eight-hour nights produced one `SLEEP_TOTAL_MIN=960` sample across both nights, then rereading only the second produced a separate 480-minute sample with a different start/end key; neither per-night history nor repeat-import idempotency is preserved by this query-window-dependent aggregation. ([Aggregation and emitted intervals](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitNormalizer.ts#L397-L439), [dedup contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/623))

**Minimal fix:** emit stable sleep-session/night samples (or stable segment observations with correct downstream aggregation), not a whole-query total; reconcile overlapping/coarse/staged sources, and test two nights, a 30-day window, incremental overlap and repeat import against server dedup.

### B-317-4 — High / must fix: Apple weight is read in pounds but persisted as kilograms

**Evidence:** `healthkit/healthKitClient.ts:353` passes the common options without `unit` to `getWeightSamples`; locked `react-native-health@1.19.0` defaults this reader to **pounds**, while `healthKitNormalizer.ts:464` forwards the value unchanged as `BODY_WEIGHT_KG`. ([Client reader](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitClient.ts#L346-L354), [locked native default, lines 43-47](https://github.com/agencyenterprise/react-native-health/blob/84d946aad6f2c3191998c04c84afc01e3f035b4c/RCTAppleHealthKit/RCTAppleHealthKit%2BMethods_Body.m#L43-L47), [normalizer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitNormalizer.ts#L453-L468))

A mock honoring that native default through the actual client/normalizer reproduced a 180-pound reading becoming **180 kg**, rather than approximately 81.65 kg; this latent helper defect becomes persisted health-data corruption when this PR activates import. ([Affected client-to-normalizer path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L164-L189))

**Minimal fix:** explicitly request `unit: 'kg'` for this native reader (or explicitly convert a documented pound result), and add client-to-normalizer plus shared-fixture coverage for a known physical weight.

### Optional findings

- **C-317-1 — Low:** `ingestBatching.ts:118` counts UTF-16 string length, not UTF-8 bytes; schema-length-valid Unicode pointer fields produced a 221,851-byte batch while the counter reported 89,611 characters. Current normalizers normally emit ASCII pointers, so this is not the present native-path blocker; use a React-Native-safe UTF-8 byte counter, reject an individually oversized sample, and assert actual encoded bytes in the test. ([Batch counter](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/ingestBatching.ts#L113-L131))
- **C-317-2 — Medium / consent UX:** `ConnectProviderSheet.tsx:238-255` discloses the 30-day history only *after* permission grant/import begins, while its pre-Continue copy describes merely device access. Show the 30-day scope and coaching use before Continue, aligned with required box 1; do not require optional AI box 2 for ordinary health collection, and keep the AI panel off. ([Connect disclosure timing](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/screens/client/wearables/ConnectProviderSheet.tsx#L238-L255), [off-by-default AI flag](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/config/featureFlags.ts#L471-L482))

### Native plugin / contracts / AI disposition

The **plugin itself is not the launch blocker found here**: it inserts the delegate after `super.onCreate` exactly once, adds one Android 14 permission-usage alias, and repeated alias application preserves an existing `ACTION_SHOW_PERMISSIONS_RATIONALE` filter; the pinned native delegate constructs activity-result contracts and registers launchers, rather than initializing/reading Health Connect on launch. ([Plugin implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/plugins/withHealthConnectPermissionDelegate.js), [native delegate](https://github.com/matinzd/react-native-health-connect/blob/b834a6251de71c2db617ab2da9e3102b2ee2450a/android/src/main/java/dev/matinzd/healthconnect/permissions/HealthConnectPermissionDelegate.kt))

This is source/mod-test evidence, **not an APK launch proof**; integrate the independently merged Crisp repair #316 (`53447a36d630b5594cfde6e14c9fd47c2ab2b402`) into the actual binary and perform Android/iPhone device passes rather than attributing that unrelated previous crash to this plugin. ([Crisp repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/316), [device acceptance script](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317))

The shared fixture hashes match at `033301173cc52458d4a1d2ee98a24df6b10aeac6137487e18f5c335687e4ec9e`; JWT-only allow-listed wire identity, RHR's `SLEEP_RECOVERY` bucket/read, request count bounds, bounded 429 retry and matched requested/read permission sets are implemented, but do not resolve the findings above. ([Shared fixture tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/__tests__/ingestContract.test.ts), [batching](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/services/health/ingestBatching.ts), [PR permission/bucket changes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317))

The client AI panel is not mounted with the off-by-default flag, and this diff does not implement consent-box-2 enforcement on other AI paths; keep `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_WEARABLE_AI_INSIGHTS` unset/off until those separate controls exist. ([Panel gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/screens/client/wearables/WearablesShell.tsx), [flag](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/f63da34e1d61d8ae9df84d1481c37697722fbedf/src/config/featureFlags.ts))

Backend #623 also requires the existing #604 throttler-isolation dependency: at its exact audited head the real guard allows only three ingest requests/hour, not the advertised 60/minute. ([Existing dependency repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/604#issuecomment-5936641633), [backend counterpart](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/623))

All local execution used `ops/heavy.sh`, shared installed dependencies and isolated read-only candidate worktrees; no code push, dependency installation, full suite, native build, production action or live DB.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#317 @ c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c — VERDICT: BLOCK

Independent T4 full-diff audit against `53447a36d630b5594cfde6e14c9fd47c2ab2b402`, including the previous findings; open counts **A=1 / B=1 / C=0**. [Candidate scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317)

### A-317-1 — Still open, narrower reproduction: the local Connect consent is attributed to the account signed in AFTER the native permission dialog

The remote-row-only automatic-upload case is repaired, but `ConnectProviderSheet.tsx:126-144` awaits the permission dialog **before** `connectOnDevice` captures the signed-in user/fence at `onDeviceSync.ts:175-178`; there is no identity/generation captured at the original Continue tap and no cancellation of that async continuation on unmount. [Permission-to-import handoff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/ConnectProviderSheet.tsx#L126-L144) [Late identity capture](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L171-L193)

Reproduction with exact source-loaded functions and deterministic seams: A starts Continue on A's phone; while the native permission promise is pending, auth changes to B and emits the auth event; A's old promise resolves `granted`; the continuing callback registers **B's** connection, records **B's** local authorization and invokes the phone-store sync with `userId=account-B, connectionId=connection-account-B`, then emits success and closes. [Callback ordering](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/ConnectProviderSheet.tsx#L126-L164) [Authorization write and sync](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L175-L193)

This is not the documented old-connection/new-JWT millisecond race: here both JWT and newly registered connection belong to B, so server connection ownership cannot reject the misattributed A-phone data. The new fence is created after the auth event, and thus considers B current throughout. [Scope construction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L175-L193) [Fence generation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/sessionFence.ts#L52-L63)

Minimal fix: capture the user and auth generation at Continue **before** the native prompt, carry that same fence through permission completion, registration, authorization storage and import, and abort the old/unmounted continuation rather than adopting the new account; add a real sheet-to-orchestrator deferred-permission regression asserting zero B registration, zero local grant and zero native read/POST after A→B, logout and same-account re-login. The current account-change test begins at registration and misses the earlier window. [Existing narrower test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/__tests__/onDeviceSync.test.ts#L151-L166)

### B-317-2 — Partially repaired but still open: incomplete imports are silently presented as completed in the sheet

The clients/services now preserve failed-type progress, resume Health Connect pages and propagate `complete:false`; `runSyncPasses` deliberately returns partial after its bound or a zero-post failed pass, but `ConnectProviderSheet.tsx:154-164` checks only `disabled` and otherwise emits `wearable_connected`, calls `onConnected` and closes without examining `complete`. [Bounded partial outcome](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L117-L131) [Discarded completion flag](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/ConnectProviderSheet.tsx#L154-L164)

The exact source-loaded sheet handler given `{kind:'imported', postedCount:10, complete:false}` produced **one close, one onConnected, one success tutorial signal, zero errors**; refresh also discards completeness, so a failed metric has no visible partial/recovery state. [Sheet consumer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/ConnectProviderSheet.tsx#L154-L164) [Refresh consumer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/WearablesShell.tsx#L86-L96)

Minimal fix: distinguish connected from history-complete; keep or show a truthful partial/error state with a working resume/retry action when `complete:false`, rather than silently closing a promised 30-day import. Add sheet integration tests for persistent failed reads, all reads failing and history exceeding MAX_IMPORT_PASSES; the current sheet mock omits `complete` entirely, so it cannot prove this requirement. [Incomplete service regression](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/__tests__/onDeviceSync.test.ts#L185-L202) [Sheet mock](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/__tests__/ConnectProviderSheet.test.tsx#L77-L91)

### Closed portions / other prior findings

- **A-317-1 remote-row-only case closed:** current user + source local authorization must match the connected remote id; the read-only probe confirmed B's remote row alone gives `not_authorized` and zero native reads. [Refresh enforcement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/onDeviceSync.ts#L205-L223)
- **B-317-1 closed:** authorization/progress keys are scoped by user, connection and provider; legacy provider-global cursors are not read, and sign-out sweeps the new namespace. [Scoped state](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts#L70-L76) [Sign-out sweep](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/authActions.ts#L93-L101)
- **B-317-2 progress-loss portion closed:** paged reads return continuation tokens; failed reads retain per-type progress; bounded passes report partial rather than falsely claiming completion at service level. [Android progress](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectSyncService.ts#L183-L225) [Apple progress](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitSyncService.ts#L199-L244)
- **B-317-3 closed for the reported whole-query aggregation/replay case:** sleep is grouped per session, overlapping intervals counted once, edge sessions deferred and incremental reads have a sleep lookback; regressions cover two nights and full/incremental equality. [Normalizer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/healthkit/healthKitNormalizer.ts#L348-L515) [Sleep regressions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/healthkit/__tests__/healthKitNormalizer.test.ts#L225-L306)
- **B-317-4 / C-317-1 / C-317-2 closed:** native weight explicitly requests kilograms with client-to-normalizer regression; batch bounds count UTF-8 and exclude oversized records; 30-day/coaching disclosure appears before Continue. [Weight test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/healthkit/__tests__/healthKitClient.test.ts#L266-L284) [Byte counter](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/services/health/ingestBatching.ts#L109-L172) [Disclosure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c7e35d847dae7cb08422d221ec0657b769192e7c/src/screens/client/wearables/ConnectProviderSheet.tsx#L302-L312)

### Evidence / launch limits

Independent local command: `node /home/user/workspace/ops/reports/AUD-SOL-317-adversarial-probes.cjs` -> exit 0, `AUDIT_PROBES_COMPLETE`; this means the two defects were reproduced, **not** that safety assertions passed.
